The response contains no assertion, so the signature, audience, time-window and attribute checks were skipped. Re-run them on the first successful response. If AADSTS75005 still appears on a separate request, capture that AuthnRequest and check it separately. Confirm the SP entity ID and ACS URL in the app registration match https://sp.example.com/saml/metadata and https://sp.example.com/saml/acs.
